gp.message:
♦️ **UA MAUA NEI LE FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions faʻatasi ma **Your script** ma **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, ma le **Flex Studio (Beta)** e muamua ona laʻu mai ae fesili atu ae leʻi faʻapipiʻiina.

*(Faʻapipiʻi i luga o lau lomiga o loʻo iai nei ma toe amata faʻatasi le After Effects.)*

♦️ **Fou: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Le faʻatulagaga **Map desk**, suʻesuʻe nofoaga e aunoa ma le initaneti, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route ma isi mea), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, sitaili faʻafanua e leai se totogi ma le **Open in Flex Maps**.
* O ona meafaigaluega faʻaopoopo (live sync, sitaili, igoa, 3D, Finalize) ua matuā laʻu moni nei i totonu o After Effects.

♦️ **Mea fou i AutoCaptions**
* O le **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (i le ao, e faʻaaogā ai credits a Flex AI) o le masini fautuaina, ua filifilia faʻatasi mo tagata uma. Toe filifili le Whisper e fai ai upu faʻaali e leai se totogi i lau komepiuta (e manaʻomia e le Translate To le Whisper). Afai e pisi le server, e faʻaali atu lou tulaga i le laina.
* **Your script**: e ave e upu faʻaali le sipelaga ma upu o lau tusitusiga i soʻo se mea na e fai ai na upu.
* Taunuuga **Editable template**: upu faʻaali o ni vaega template e mafai ona e suia le sitaili i le Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* E leai se mea ua filifilia ma ua avanoa le Source media? E ofo mai le **composition atoa**. O le leo lava e tasi e toe faʻaaogā lana tusitusiga.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* O le **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** e muamua laʻu mai, ona fesili mai lea **Install / Not now**.
* Le polokalame (2.0.0-beta.2): nofoaga faigaluega **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, ki o meafaigaluega a After Effects, e tatala vave kilipi, ma e aoga le OPEN i precomps ma vaega faʻasaʻo (adjustment layers).

♦️ **Ua Faʻaleleia**
* Ua toe foʻi mai aafiaga o autu na misi i le tele o PC Windows (e mama atu pe a tape aafiaga animation a Windows).

♦️ **Nofoaga filifiliga mo le puipuiga o le laisene**
* E fesili faʻatasi, ma e le faʻamalosia: o le **No thanks** e faʻaauau pea ona galue mea uma. Sui i le **Flex Settings > Privacy**. E teuina mo le 12 masina, e le faʻatau atu lava, e le faʻasoa atu lava sei vagana ua manaʻomia e le tulafono.

ult.message:
♦️ **UA MAUA NEI LE FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Ua siitia le Caption Stack i totonu o AutoCaptions** ma sitaili, faʻatulagaga, gaioiga ma leo mo upu taʻitasi. Ua galue le **UN-NEST** ma blend modes i Premiere 26.5, o le **AUTO CUT** o se oomi e tasi, ma e tatala e le **Flex Studio (Beta)** lau kilipi mai le panel.

*(Faʻapipiʻi i luga o lau lomiga o loʻo iai nei ma toe amata faʻatasi le Premiere Pro.)*

♦️ **Fou: Upu faʻaali gaioi i AutoCaptions**
* **Sitaili o upu**: tuʻu i soʻo se upu ona lanu, font ma se faʻaiuga Flat, Shine poʻo Glow.
* **Faʻatulagaga o laina**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside ma Line.
* **Gaioiga mo upu taʻitasi** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake ma isi) ma se vaʻaiga muamua, faʻapea ma leo **Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. E manaʻomia e sitaili o upu ma gaioiga le taunuuga **Images**.
* O le **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (i le ao, e faʻaaogā ai credits a Flex AI) ua avea nei ma masini fautuaina, ua filifilia faʻatasi mo tagata uma; filifili se masini Whisper e fai ai upu faʻaali e aunoa ma le initaneti ma e leai se totogi.
* **Your script** (Captions mode): e ave e upu faʻaali upu o lau tusitusiga i mea na e fai ai na upu.
* Pe a leai se mea ua filifilia (ua avanoa le kata Source) e ofo mai le **timeline atoa**; e teu upu faʻaali i autafa o lau poloketi.

♦️ **Fou: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* O le **Open in Flex Studio** e siaki (track) le kilipi i le polokalame; o le **APPLY TO PREMIERE** e toe auina mai le track. E leʻi faʻapipiʻiina? O le **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** e laʻu mai, ona fesili mai lea **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Ua Suia**
* O le **AUTO CUT** e suʻesuʻe se kilipi ua filifilia ma tipi i se oomi e tasi. O le **Retakes** e maua laina na toe amata.
* O le **Audio Studio** ua ono ona vaega laiti (sub-tabs). O le **Library** ua i ai nei i le Nest Saver.

♦️ **Ua Faʻaleleia**
* **UN-NEST** i Premiere 26.5 (na teena nest uma), ma blend modes e pei o Screen na toe foʻi i Normal (Premiere i le Igilisi).
* Le chip mumu **AUTOSAVE 0:00**, le vaʻaiga muamua uliuli o Caption Stack, ma aafiaga o autu na misi i le tele o PC Windows.

♦️ **Nofoaga filifiliga mo le puipuiga o le laisene**
* E fesili faʻatasi, ma e le faʻamalosia: o le **No thanks** e faʻaauau pea ona galue mea uma. Sui i le **Flex Settings > Privacy**. E teuina mo le 12 masina, e le faʻatau atu lava, e le faʻasoa atu lava sei vagana ua manaʻomia e le tulafono.
